description:

Length: Medium (10 - 30 hours)  
Developer: D.O.  
Publishers:   
Language: English  
Voice: Japanese  
Animation: Simple animations  
Uncensored  
  
Description:  
Kana ~ Okaeri (Welcome Home Kana), the complete re-make of one of the most beautiful Japanese visual novels ever made, that adds updated, larger graphics by Ayakaze Ryosho as well as full voice to the entire game and some animated scenes. A wonderful way to experience the journey of Kana all over again...  
In Kana Imouto ~ Okaeri, you have a sister who's two years younger than you named Kana, who has been ill all her life, spending more time in the hospital than at home. In the past you felt jealous of the special attention Kana received in your family, though in recent years you've come to treasure your younger sister instead, wanting to do anything to help her. Though life is never simple -- your long and complex relationship with Yumi can attest to that -- in the end all you wan to do is find a way to save your dear little sister. The reason is...you love her.

Windows 95, 98, Me, 2000, XP, Vista, 7, 8 (32 or 64 bit OK)  
350 MB hard drive, 32 MB Memory, Pentium II or higher processor recommended, DirectX compatible graphics and sound card.

The game itself takes place in early 21st century Tokyo, which has been transformed into a haven for Japanese culture thanks to the nationalistic ideals of the charismatic Ishima Kaigen. Strict policies are in place in to enforce a ban upon firearms within the city limits.
